summary: Deterministic Quick Dev identity projections for plan toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; excludes logs/ and plan-state.v1.json/resume-state.v1.json; rejects absolute, parent-traversing, symlink, escaping, or excluded identity paths; hashes canonical JSON with SHA-256; loads and validates implementation contract plan_id and slice list; candidate manifest combines allowed_changes and planned_new_files, normalizes tools paths, records present/absent files, sorts entries; dependency identities include dependent candidate hashes; per-slice identity includes candidate_hash, predicate_input_root, authority_root, validator_root, validator_version, closure_definition_hash, validator_hash; predicate incorporates slice, contract, registry, candidate; authority inputs include authority manifest, ADR-0060, skill input contract, lifecycle state contract, consumer policies; validator inputs include validate_all, validate_plan_ready, terminal_full, migration_bridge, route_plan_directory, build_slice_invocation, loop_plan_directory; exposes slice_validation_snapshot and aggregate validation_snapshot; ambiguity: filesystem state and contract contents determine computed hashes.
